referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official MFL Painting San Diego homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a coastal-house image carries a navy overlay, stacked gold-and-white statement, and an estimate form alongside. It uses small white service navigation with a gold estimate action. The visual system relies on large modern sans statements, small uppercase labels, and compact practical copy; surfaces include warm cream, navy, white and accents include gold, sky blue. Imagery is residential project photography with a few before-and-after work scenes. The page then runs through coastal-home and form hero, navy business introduction, three audience cards, service list, four-step process, three-project gallery, San Diego area grid, review cards, FAQ and estimate close. Its service presentation is service list for interior, exterior, cabinetry, and wood staining followed by process and project context. Mobile changes to keep the gold estimate action easy to reach, stack audience and service entries, and maintain project images at useful size. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy MFL logo, faith statement, license number, project photos, timelines, reviews, guarantees, or service-area claims.
